protocol.failed_run_policy: Include every run in success statistics and use only the explicitly marked pre-fall interval for tracking errors.
protocol.music_clock_policy: Use one fixed audio clock for M_ref and M_exec; never optimize their audio offsets independently.
protocol.comparison_policy: Pair routes by song, clip start, duration and generation seed; hold M_ref fixed across tracker repeats.

metrics.name: Motion schema validity
metrics.definition: Validate finite root_pos[T,3], root_rot[T,4], dof_pos[T,29] and a positive FPS.
metrics.acceptance_rule: 100% pass

metrics.name: Interface convention validity
metrics.definition: Validate G1 joint order, units, coordinate frame and quaternion convention against the frozen manifest.
metrics.acceptance_rule: 100% pass

metrics.name: Clock and audio alignment validity
metrics.definition: Validate a shared audio, generation, reference and feedback time base including audio_start_seconds.
metrics.acceptance_rule: 100% pass

metrics.name: Feedback coverage
metrics.definition: Fraction of the requested execution timeline covered by valid measured feedback.

metrics.name: Kinetic FID
metrics.definition: Frechet distance between generated and GT kinetic feature distributions using a frozen extractor.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report with PFC, FSR and human preference; never use alone.

metrics.name: Geometric FID
metrics.definition: Frechet distance between generated and GT geometric feature distributions using a frozen extractor.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report with PFC, FSR and human preference; never use alone.

metrics.name: Physical Foot Contact
metrics.definition: Acceleration-based kinematic plausibility score relating body acceleration to static foot contact.
metrics.acceptance_rule: No significant degradation versus the preregistered baseline.

metrics.name: Foot Skating Ratio
metrics.definition: Fraction of frames with horizontal foot motion while the foot is within the fixed ground-contact height.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report with PFC because intentional dance slides can raise FSR.

metrics.name: Ground penetration
metrics.definition: Ground penetration depth and affected-frame ratio for feet and preregistered key bodies.
metrics.aggregation: median, P95 and maximum per trajectory
metrics.acceptance_rule: Compare with GT-calibrated range.

metrics.name: Kinetic diversity
metrics.definition: Mean pairwise distance in the frozen kinetic feature space.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target the GT confidence interval; higher is not automatically better.

metrics.name: Geometric diversity
metrics.definition: Mean pairwise distance in the frozen geometric feature space.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target the GT confidence interval; higher is not automatically better.

metrics.name: Joint dynamics distribution
metrics.definition: Velocity, acceleration and jerk P50/P95/P99/max for full body and body groups.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Compare with GT and SONIC capability envelopes.

metrics.name: Motion energy
metrics.definition: Mean squared joint velocity over the evaluated interval.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target GT range and report together with jerk.

metrics.name: Static ratio
metrics.definition: Fraction of frames below the frozen smoothed joint-speed threshold.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target GT range; low static ratio is not sufficient without physical quality.

metrics.name: Long-term pose repetition
metrics.definition: Fraction of frames whose nearest nonlocal pose after the fixed exclusion interval is below the frozen RMS threshold.
metrics.acceptance_rule: No significant increase versus GT or the preregistered baseline.

metrics.name: C4 boundary continuity
metrics.definition: Position and velocity jumps at commit boundaries divided by corresponding non-boundary jumps.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target 1.0; freeze commit boundary definition before comparison.

metrics.name: Root behavior
metrics.definition: Planar path, net displacement, speed, yaw rate and root-height distribution.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Compare with GT; global root XY is not a primary SONIC tracking target.

metrics.name: Beat Alignment Score
metrics.definition: Mean exponential proximity from each detected kinematic beat to its nearest music beat.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Never use alone; report motion-beat count and coverage.

metrics.name: Beat precision, recall and F1
metrics.definition: Fixed-tolerance matching between generated motion beats and explicit target beats.
metrics.acceptance_rule: N/A when no explicit beat target is provided.

metrics.name: Beat Assignment Precision
metrics.definition: Fraction of generated dance beats correctly assigned to designated beat frames.
metrics.acceptance_rule: N/A when no beat assignment is provided.

metrics.name: Key Pose Distance
metrics.definition: Mean squared local Cartesian joint-position error at designated keyframes.
metrics.acceptance_rule: N/A when no keypose target is provided.

metrics.name: Onset-motion response
metrics.definition: Correlation between fixed audio onset strength and motion impact or energy envelope.
metrics.aggregation: per trajectory; zero-lag and best-lag values
metrics.acceptance_rule: Interpret best lag only when best correlation >= 0.10.

metrics.name: Music response lag
metrics.definition: Lag at maximum onset-motion correlation under the frozen lag window.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Target zero; do not optimize audio offset independently for M_ref and M_exec.

metrics.name: Tempo consistency and phase error
metrics.definition: Error between motion periodicity/accent phase and the fixed music rhythm grid.
metrics.unit: BPM error and circular phase error
metrics.acceptance_rule: M2 paired improvement over M0 with a frozen detector.

metrics.name: Audio-motion R@1, R@2 and R@3
metrics.definition: Fraction of audio queries for which the paired motion is retrieved within the top K using a frozen independent encoder.
metrics.acceptance_rule: M2 must improve over M0; encoder must not be tuned on the test set.

metrics.name: Multimodal Distance
metrics.definition: Mean frozen-embedding distance between paired audio and motion.
metrics.acceptance_rule: M2 must improve over M0; encoder must not be tuned on the test set.

metrics.name: Phrase-boundary response
metrics.definition: Motion-structure response rate and lag around frozen musical phrase and intensity boundaries.
metrics.acceptance_rule: M2 paired improvement over M0 without generator-quality regression.

metrics.name: Reference dynamic-envelope violation
metrics.definition: Fraction and magnitude of reference velocity, acceleration and jerk outside the GT-calibrated SONIC capability envelope.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Freeze from GT capability tests before model evaluation.

metrics.name: Reference joint-limit violation
metrics.definition: Fraction and maximum magnitude of G1 joint-position limit violations.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Zero violations.

metrics.name: Execution success rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of runs completing the preregistered duration without fall or trajectory-deviation failure.
metrics.acceptance_rule: >= 0.95 over the frozen 60 s test matrix

metrics.name: Time to fall
metrics.definition: Time from the formal motion start to first failure, treating completed runs as right-censored.
metrics.aggregation: survival curve and median where defined
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report all failures and exact failure timestamps.

metrics.name: Mean per-joint position error
metrics.definition: Mean DoF rotation error between reference and measured robot state.
metrics.aggregation: full body, body groups and per joint
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report raw and lag-compensated variants.

metrics.name: Mean per-keybody position error
metrics.definition: Mean Cartesian position error over frozen G1 key bodies.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Use the frozen G1 key-body set and root-relative convention because SONIC does not track global root XY.

metrics.name: Raw joint RMSE
metrics.definition: Joint-position RMSE on the unshifted end-to-end timeline.
metrics.aggregation: full body, body groups and per joint
metrics.acceptance_rule: Always report together with lag-compensated RMSE.

metrics.name: Lag-compensated joint RMSE
metrics.definition: Joint-position RMSE after only the frozen tracking-lag alignment procedure.
metrics.aggregation: full body, body groups and per joint
metrics.acceptance_rule: Alignment parameters must be fixed before model comparison.

metrics.name: Tracking lag
metrics.definition: Cross-correlation lag between reference and measured joint trajectories.
metrics.aggregation: median and P95 for full body, body groups and joints

metrics.name: Amplitude retention
metrics.definition: Measured-to-reference ratio of robust joint amplitude P95-P5.
metrics.aggregation: median, IQR, P5 and P95 by body group
metrics.acceptance_rule: Provisional median target 0.85 to 1.15, subject to GT calibration.

metrics.name: Motion-energy retention
metrics.definition: Measured-to-reference ratio of mean squared joint velocity.
metrics.aggregation: median, IQR, P5 and P95 by body group
metrics.acceptance_rule: Provisional median >= 0.70, subject to GT calibration.

metrics.name: Frequency-band power retention
metrics.definition: Measured-to-reference Welch PSD power ratio in 0-1 Hz, 1-3 Hz and 3-8 Hz bands.
metrics.aggregation: median, IQR, P5 and P95 by body group and band
metrics.acceptance_rule: Provisional 3-8 Hz median >= 0.50, subject to GT calibration.

metrics.name: Contact retention
metrics.definition: Foot-contact state F1, contact-transition timing error and execution-minus-reference foot slip.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Freeze contact detector using GT before model comparison.

metrics.name: Executed music-expression retention
metrics.definition: Paired M_exec minus M_ref changes for valid music metrics on one fixed audio clock.
metrics.acceptance_rule: The M2-over-M0 music advantage must remain detectable in M_exec.

metrics.name: Generator deadline miss rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of online commits not available by the frozen execution deadline.
metrics.aggregation: rate, longest miss streak and P95 lateness

metrics.name: End-to-end latency decomposition
metrics.definition: Audio-to-feature, feature-to-motion, motion-to-reference and reference-to-execution latencies.
metrics.aggregation: mean, P50, P95, P99 and maximum per stage
metrics.acceptance_rule: Report every stage and hardware; average inference time alone is insufficient.

metrics.name: Realtime factor
metrics.definition: Valid generated and executed motion duration divided by wall-clock duration.

metrics.name: Blind pairwise preference
metrics.definition: Independent ratings of naturalness, dance quality, expressiveness, long-term coherence, rhythm and music-style match.
metrics.aggregation: Bradley-Terry or Elo with participant-aware bootstrap 95% CI
metrics.applicability: paper claims about beauty, naturalness and music appropriateness
metrics.acceptance_rule: Required for aesthetic claims; randomize side and hold audio, camera and duration fixed.

tracker_provisional.calibration_rule: Freeze thresholds from GT capability tests before formal model evaluation.

music_conditioning.required_result: M2 must show paired improvement over M0 in at least one preregistered semantic metric and one temporal-structure metric, with trajectory-level 95% CI excluding zero, no material generator-quality regression, retained advantage after SONIC, and supporting human preference.
